test_plan.strategy: Test the AI layer in isolation with a stub OpenAI-compatible provider (no real network). Unit tests cover the redaction, timeout, and config logic in internal/ai; integration tests drive the HTTP handlers and the notify alert path against an in-memory SQLite DB and a fake provider/telegram sender; e2e tests drive the Settings AI section and the explanation panel in the browser at 375px/1440px. Read-only is enforced structurally (no import of privileged/docker/systemd) and asserted behaviorally (audit log unchanged after an explanation). Every existing alert/notification path is protected by regression assertions.

test_cases.title: Explain a fired insight returns grounded cause + remediation
preconditions: ai_settings: enabled=1, endpoint=stub, model=test-model, key set
stub provider returns a fixed completion citing cpu_temp
test_cases.given: ai_settings enabled with stub provider; active insight rule_id=8 with cpu_temp=78
test_cases.when: POST /api/ai/explain { scope: 'insight', insight_id: 8 } with a valid session+CSRF
test_cases.then: HTTP 200; body.cause non-empty; body.remediation non-empty; body.cited_signals includes 'cpu_temp' or 'rule_id=8'; body.latency_ms <= 10000
test_cases.expected_result: 200 with cause+remediation text and cited_signals containing the supplied signal; latency_ms <= 10000

test_cases.title: Prompt stays within size caps at production-scale telemetry
preconditions: snapshot source holds 10000 metric points and 5000 log lines
test_cases.given: a TelemetrySnapshot source with 10000 metric points across series and 5000 recent log lines
test_cases.when: ai.buildPrompt(snapshot) is called with the configured caps (N points/series, M=200 log lines)
test_cases.then: the composed prompt includes <= M log lines and <= N points per series; total prompt bytes <= 32768
steps: assert caps applied and byte bound
test_cases.expected_result: prompt truncated to caps: <=200 log lines, <=N points/series, total <= 32768 bytes

test_cases.title: Insufficient telemetry returns explicit message, takes no action
preconditions: no anomalous telemetry / empty insight set
audit_log row count recorded before call
test_cases.given: ai_settings enabled but telemetry snapshot has no anomalous signal and no active insight
test_cases.then: HTTP 422, body { error: 'insufficient telemetry to explain' }; no fabricated cause; audit_log row count unchanged (no control action)
test_cases.expected_result: 422 with error 'insufficient telemetry to explain'; audit_log count identical before/after

test_cases.title: Saved API key is ciphertext at rest and decrypts back
test_cases.given: ULTRON_SECRET_KEY set and ai_settings empty
test_cases.when: POST /api/settings/ai { enabled:1, endpoint_url:'https://x', model:'m', api_key:'sk-secret123' } then read ai_settings.api_key_enc directly from SQLite
test_cases.then: api_key_enc bytes do NOT equal 'sk-secret123'; decrypting api_key_enc via secrets returns exactly 'sk-secret123'
test_cases.expected_result: stored blob != 'sk-secret123' and decrypt(api_key_enc) == 'sk-secret123'

test_cases.title: Secrets round-trip: encrypt produces non-plaintext, decrypt restores
test_cases.given: a 32-byte AES key and plaintext 'sk-secret123'
test_cases.then: Encrypt output != 'sk-secret123' and length > plaintext (nonce+tag); Decrypt(output) == 'sk-secret123'
test_cases.expected_result: ciphertext differs from and is longer than plaintext; decrypt restores 'sk-secret123' exactly

test_cases.title: Raw key never returned by GET and never appears in logs
test_cases.given: ai_settings with api_key 'sk-secret123' saved and a captured server log buffer
test_cases.when: GET /api/settings/ai, then POST /api/ai/explain, then scan the log buffer and the GET response
test_cases.then: GET body has api_key:'' and api_key_set:true; substring 'sk-secret123' appears in NEITHER the GET response NOR any captured log line
test_cases.expected_result: GET returns api_key='' api_key_set=true; zero occurrences of 'sk-secret123' in logs or responses

test_cases.title: AI config persists across reload
test_cases.given: Settings page open, AI section empty
test_cases.when: toggle Enable AI on, enter endpoint 'https://api.example/v1', model 'qwen2.5:14b', key 'sk-x', click Save, reload the page
test_cases.then: after reload the endpoint field shows 'https://api.example/v1', model shows 'qwen2.5:14b', key shows the masked placeholder, Enable AI is on
test_cases.expected_result: endpoint and model re-render with saved values; key field shows masked placeholder; toggle stays on

test_cases.title: AI settings section renders without horizontal scroll at 375px
test_cases.given: Settings page at a 375px viewport with the AI section expanded
test_cases.then: document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth <= 375; fields are single-column stacked; every interactive control has min-height >= 44px
test_cases.expected_result: no horizontal scroll at 375px; single-column layout; tap targets >= 44px

test_cases.title: Enable on with empty endpoint blocks save with inline error
test_cases.given: Settings AI section with Enable AI on and the Endpoint URL field empty
test_cases.then: an inline error 'Endpoint URL is required when AI is enabled' appears next to the field; no network save occurs; GET /api/settings/ai still returns enabled:false
test_cases.expected_result: inline validation error shown; config not persisted (enabled remains false)

test_cases.title: Panel works with zero AI errors when unconfigured
test_cases.given: ai_settings disabled with no key
test_cases.then: both return HTTP 200; the captured logs contain zero lines matching /ai:.*error/i; the 'Explain with AI' control is rendered disabled or absent
test_cases.expected_result: 200 on both pages; zero AI-error log lines; Explain control not active

test_cases.title: Service.Enabled() false when disabled; Explain returns ErrNotConfigured
test_cases.given: an ai.Service built from Config{ enabled:false }
test_cases.when: svc.Enabled() and svc.Explain(ctx, ScopeSystem) are called
test_cases.then: Enabled() returns false; Explain returns ai.ErrNotConfigured and a nil *Explanation
test_cases.expected_result: Enabled()==false; Explain returns (nil, ai.ErrNotConfigured)

test_cases.title: Explain endpoint returns 409, never 500, when unconfigured
test_cases.given: ai_settings disabled (no key)
test_cases.when: POST /api/ai/explain { scope:'system' } with a valid session+CSRF
test_cases.then: HTTP 409 with body { error: 'AI not configured' }; status is not 500; server process keeps serving (subsequent GET /health == 200)
test_cases.expected_result: 409 'AI not configured'; no 500/panic; /health still 200

test_cases.title: Changing model in Settings changes model used on next request
preconditions: stub provider records the 'model' field of each request
test_cases.given: ai_settings enabled with model 'model-a' and a stub provider that records request.model
test_cases.then: the stub provider's last recorded request.model == 'model-b'; no process restart occurred between the two calls
test_cases.expected_result: provider request used model 'model-b' with no restart

test_cases.title: Client builds a valid chat-completions request for any base URL
test_cases.given: two configs with endpoint 'https://a.test/v1' and 'https://b.test/v1', model 'm'
test_cases.when: client.buildRequest(cfg, prompt) is called for each
test_cases.then: each produces a POST to '<base>/chat/completions' with JSON body containing model:'m' and a messages array; Authorization header 'Bearer <key>' is set
steps: assert path, model, messages, auth header
test_cases.expected_result: both requests target <base>/chat/completions with correct model, messages, and Bearer auth

test_cases.title: Unreachable endpoint returns typed error, no panic
test_cases.given: ai_settings enabled with an unreachable endpoint URL
test_cases.then: HTTP 502 with body { error: 'provider error: ...' } (human-readable); process does not panic; GET /health == 200 afterwards
test_cases.expected_result: 502 with a readable provider error; no panic; /health 200

test_cases.title: Fast provider returns within bound; server stays responsive
test_cases.given: ai_settings enabled, stub provider replies in 100ms, timeout_ms=10000
test_cases.then: explain returns 200 in < 1000ms; the concurrent GET /health returns 200 in < 200ms
test_cases.expected_result: explain 200 < 1s; concurrent /health 200 < 200ms

test_cases.title: Request aborts at the configured timeout boundary
test_cases.given: ai.Service with timeout_ms=1000 and a stub provider that sleeps 3000ms
test_cases.when: svc.Explain(ctx, ScopeSystem) is called and timed
test_cases.then: Explain returns a deadline-exceeded error in between 1000ms and 1300ms (not 3000ms)
test_cases.expected_result: context.DeadlineExceeded returned within ~1s (<=1300ms), not after 3s

test_cases.title: Provider 401/malformed body yields clear error, no crash
preconditions: stub provider returns HTTP 401 then a malformed JSON body
test_cases.given: ai_settings enabled, stub provider returns HTTP 401 with body 'unauthorized'
test_cases.then: HTTP 502 with body { error: 'provider error: 401 ...' }; process still alive (GET /health == 200); no goroutine panic logged
test_cases.expected_result: 502 with provider 401 error; /health 200; no panic

test_cases.title: Explanation panel shows loading then success state
preconditions: AI configured with stub provider returning a fixed explanation
test_cases.given: dashboard open at 375px with AI configured and a fired insight
test_cases.when: click 'Explain with AI' on the insight
test_cases.then: a loading indicator appears within 200ms; it is replaced by a panel showing 'PROBABLE CAUSE' and 'SUGGESTED REMEDIATION' text; document scrollWidth <= 375 (no horizontal scroll)
test_cases.expected_result: loading <=200ms then success panel with cause+remediation; no horizontal scroll at 375px

test_cases.title: Empty state when telemetry insufficient is not blank
test_cases.given: AI configured and the explain endpoint returns 422 insufficient
test_cases.then: the panel shows the empty state with text containing 'Not enough recent data' and a visible Retry button; the panel body is not empty
test_cases.expected_result: empty state shows 'Not enough recent data...' plus a Retry button; no blank panel

test_cases.title: Error state shows reason + retry on provider failure
preconditions: AI configured; backend returns 502 provider error
test_cases.given: AI configured and the explain endpoint returns 502 { error:'provider error: 401' }
test_cases.then: the panel shows an error state with a one-line reason containing '401' and a Retry button; the panel is not blank
test_cases.expected_result: error state shows the one-line '401' reason and a Retry affordance; not blank

test_cases.title: Redactor removes a known secret value from telemetry
preconditions: DB secrets table contains telegram token 'bot12345:AAblahblah'
test_cases.given: a snapshot whose log line is 'sent via token bot12345:AAblahblah' and a secrets set containing 'bot12345:AAblahblah'
test_cases.then: the returned text contains '[REDACTED]' and contains zero occurrences of 'bot12345:AAblahblah'
steps: build snapshot with secret in a log line
test_cases.expected_result: output has no 'bot12345:AAblahblah' substring and shows [REDACTED] in its place

test_cases.title: Redactor strips secret-shaped token not in the DB
test_cases.given: a log line 'Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.abc.def' with an empty DB secrets set
test_cases.then: the bearer/JWT token is pattern-redacted: output contains '[REDACTED]' and no 'eyJhbGciOi' substring
test_cases.expected_result: JWT-shaped token replaced with [REDACTED]; no 'eyJhbGciOi' in output

test_cases.title: Outbound prompt and logs carry no DB secret (3 vectors)
preconditions: DB has telegram token 'bot999:AAtok', SMTP pass 'smtpP@ss1', AI key 'sk-aikey9'
test_cases.given: DB secrets {telegram 'bot999:AAtok', smtp 'smtpP@ss1', ai key 'sk-aikey9'} and telemetry that embeds all three
test_cases.when: POST /api/ai/explain runs and the outbound provider request body + server logs are captured
test_cases.then: the captured provider request body contains NONE of 'bot999:AAtok','smtpP@ss1','sk-aikey9'; the log buffer also contains none of the three
steps: assert zero matches for each of the 3 secrets
test_cases.expected_result: zero occurrences of any of the 3 secret values in the outbound prompt or the logs

test_cases.title: Alert fire sends rule-based message then AI follow-up
preconditions: fake telegram sender records messages in order
stub AI provider returns an explanation
test_cases.given: AI configured, telegram_push on, a fake telegram sender, and a cpu_temp threshold alert that fires
test_cases.when: the alert dispatch runs to completion (including async AI follow-up)
test_cases.then: the fake sender received exactly 2 messages in order: [0] the rule-based alert text, [1] a message starting with '🤖 AI analysis'
steps: assert 2 messages ordered: alert then AI note
test_cases.expected_result: 2 telegram messages: rule-based alert first, then '🤖 AI analysis' follow-up

test_cases.title: Push toggle off sends only the rule-based alert
test_cases.given: AI configured but telegram_push off, and an alert that fires
test_cases.then: the fake sender received exactly 1 message (the rule-based alert); no message starting with '🤖 AI analysis' was sent
test_cases.expected_result: exactly 1 telegram message (rule-based only); no AI follow-up

test_cases.title: AI failure does not drop or duplicate the rule-based alert
test_cases.given: AI configured, telegram_push on, but the AI provider errors/times out, and an alert fires
test_cases.when: the alert dispatch runs to completion
test_cases.then: the fake sender received exactly 1 message (the rule-based alert) — not zero, not two; an AI-failure line is present in the logs
test_cases.expected_result: exactly 1 rule-based message delivered; no duplicate, none dropped; AI failure logged
